issue.body:
https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/7ef5e392ce26ab04ba28c55b9d7e22c90f26380f/addons/knobs/src/components/types/Color.js#L87

It looks like the `hex` value is set and passed back up to the story from the color picker. But if I instantiate it with a transparent color (eg. `rgba(255,0,0,.5)`), the `.5` is discarded - both in the color picker itself (interacting with the opacity field does not work) and in the return value.

Is this a bug? How can we address it?

issue.body:
Issue: #802 

## What I did

Instead of just passing `color.hex`, also pass the alpha value.

## How to test

Add `addon-knobs` and use `color()` to enable the knob in the story, then try dragging the opacity slider in the color picker or manually setting an alpha value in the field labeled "A".

Re: automated testing, not sure. LMK!
